gaps.cause: printed section difference (bond/loan proceeds among combining-schedule revenues)
gaps.explanation: Nothing is missing and nothing is counted twice. Detail governmental revenue 4,872,571 = statement 2,817,571 (p5 Total revenues: General 1,398,229 + Street 635,329 + Sales Tax 506,747 + Debt Service 162,930 + Economic Development 13,863 + Keno 100,473) + 2,055,000. The 2,055,000 is detail 27, General Fund (Fire Fund sub-column) 'Bond/loan proceeds' 2,055,000, printed on the p14 General Fund Combining Schedule among REVENUES (Fire Fund Total revenues 2,194,276; schedule Total column Total revenues 3,453,229 = 1,398,229 + 2,055,000). The governmental funds statement prints the same 2,055,000 in the General Fund column under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), 'Bond/loan proceeds' (p6), so the JSON has it as debt_proceeds 2,055,000, not as a receipt (p5 General Fund Total revenues 1,398,229). Same money, one detail line; it is the only detail line holding the debt proceeds, so it is not removed or relabelled (the schedule prints it as revenue). Without the 2,055,000 the detail revenue equals the statement to the dollar (gap exactly 2,055,000).
